sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: Which symbol is used to create an absolute cell reference in a spreadsheet formula to keep a row or column constant?
Which presentation view is specifically designed to display all slides simultaneously as miniature thumbnails for easy rearranging?
True or False: Utilizing a single, easy-to-remember password across multiple online accounts is a highly recommended cyber safety practice.
What is the correct built-in spreadsheet function used to identify the highest numeric value within a specific range of cells from C1 to C10?
A malicious software program that disguises itself as a legitimate or useful application to trick users into installing it is known as:
True or False: The Slide Master feature enables a user to apply consistent overarching layout, font, and background formatting to all slides simultaneously.
What is the technical term for the visual and motion effects applied when a presentation moves completely from one slide to the next?
Which spreadsheet feature automatically completes a recognized logical series of data (such as months of the year or sequential numbers) when the cell handle is dragged?
True or False: The presence of 'HTTPS' in a website URL indicates that the data transmitted between the browser and the web server is securely encrypted.
Which of the following is an inappropriate and harmful practice when attempting to address or prevent a cyberbullying incident?
options: A) Blocking the bully's accounts immediately
B) Retaliating with abusive and threatening messages
C) Reporting the incident to parents or school authorities
D) Saving digital screenshots as evidence
questions.answer: B) Retaliating with abusive and threatening messages

questions.question_text: Explain the fundamental purpose of applying a data filter to a column in a large, complex spreadsheet. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A data filter temporarily hides rows that do not meet specified criteria, allowing users to quickly isolate, find, and analyze specific subsets of information within a massive dataset.

questions.question_text: Differentiate clearly between Slide Transitions and Custom Animations within a digital presentation software environment. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Slide transitions dictate the visual effects when moving between entire slides, whereas custom animations control the movement of individual elements, like text boxes or images, upon a single slide.

questions.question_text: Define the term 'firewall' in the strict context of computer and network cyber security protocols. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A firewall is a network security system that actively monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predetermined rules, acting as a digital barrier against unauthorized access.

questions.question_text: Outline the standard syntax for the IF function in an electronic spreadsheet, and state its logical capability. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The syntax is =IF(condition, value_if_true, value_if_false). It executes a logical test, returning one designated value if the condition is met and a different value if it is not.

questions.question_text: Briefly describe the specific character components a strong, secure password must contain to effectively resist brute-force hacking attempts. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A robust password should be at least eight characters long and include a complex mixture of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numerical digits, and special typographical symbols.

questions.question_text: Write out the exact steps required to generate a basic pie chart comparing the monthly departmental expenses stored in spreadsheet columns A and B. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: First, select the relevant data range across columns A and B. Next, click the 'Insert' tab on the ribbon, choose the 'Pie Chart' option, and add descriptive data labels to visually display the percentage breakdown of each expense category.

questions.question_text: Explain how utilizing a Master Slide dramatically improves workflow efficiency when a designer is creating a 50-slide corporate presentation. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: A Master Slide centrally stores the overarching theme, typography, and logo placements. By editing just this master template once, the layout of all 50 slides automatically synchronizes, saving immense time and guaranteeing strict visual consistency across the entire presentation.

questions.question_text: Read the following case context: Rahul connects to a free, passwordless public Wi-Fi network at a local café to log into his online banking portal. The next day, he discovers several unauthorized financial transactions. Deduce the likely cyber threat that occurred, and outline three critical preventive measures he should have taken. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The threat is likely a man-in-the-middle attack or packet sniffing conducted over the unsecured public Wi-Fi. To prevent this, Rahul must never access sensitive financial accounts on public networks. He should consistently use a reliable Virtual Private Network (VPN) to encrypt his data traffic and verify that the banking portal utilizes a secure HTTPS connection.

questions.question_text: A teacher wants to calculate the total marks, overall percentage, and a dynamic pass/fail status for a class of 40 students using a spreadsheet. Detail the specific formulas and functions she would use for these three distinct calculations, assuming individual subject marks are located in columns C through G. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: For total marks, she applies the AutoSum function: =SUM(C2:G2). For the percentage, she divides that total by the maximum possible score (e.g., 500) and multiplies by 100: =H2/500*100. For the dynamic pass/fail status, she utilizes the IF function: =IF(I2>=40, "Pass", "Fail"). She then uses AutoFill to drag these formulas down the respective columns.
